analysis_unit: independent paired process block; requests are subsamples
primary_metric: ordinary median of 30*C steady per-request latencies; geometric mean paired R0/R1
scope: SKV6 to SKV5, single physical HCA per worker, one route, 512KiB stripes, forced application storage path, buffered tier_a file reads, warm OS page cache, recovery disabled
timing_boundary: request excludes subsequent full-pattern hashing; concurrency4 batch wall/CPU includes coordination and hashing; concurrency1 CPU narrower
adoption: opt-in/default off; no inference, production, p99 or dual-HCA claim
deployment_selection: main deployment result regardless of direction or magnitude; debug separately retained
storage_interpretation: tier_a4 workers; pointer read via std::fs::File::open and read_exact, buffered; forced path bypasses application L1 but does not prove physical media access; OS page cache not cleared
cross_profile_boundary: debug/release have different build features and source snapshot; no sole-cause compiler or guard speedup attribution
